name: Multipart entry dump preserves every stable-population key across buffer boundaries
setup: $TC p4template create action/reads65/ingress/send_nh actid 1 param port_id type dev param dmac type macaddr param smac type macaddr
$TC p4template create table/reads65/ingress/nh_table tblid 1 type exact keysz 32 permissions 0x3da4 tentries 128 nummasks 1 table_acts act name reads65/ingress/send_nh flags tableonly

sh -c 'set -e; for i in $(seq 1 65); do $TC p4ctrl create reads65/table/ingress/nh_table srcAddr 192.0.2.$i action reads65/ingress/send_nh param port_id lo param dmac 02:aa:00:00:00:01 param smac 02:bb:00:00:00:01; done'
verifyCmd: python3 -c 'import json; roots=json.load(open("/tmp/p4tc-multipart-$TESTID.json")); entries=[e for root in roots for e in root.get("entries",[])]; keys=[e["key"][0]["fieldval"].split("/")[0] for e in entries]; wanted={"192.0.2."+str(i) for i in range(1,66)}; print("complete population" if len(keys)==65 and set(keys)==wanted else "incomplete population: "+str(keys))'

name: Filtered table dump consumes the complete CLI expression
